text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh! Crackle, rumble!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! The rain's really comin' down!
There's a
tree by the road I can go hide
under—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Fuji? Looks like you beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, El, you're taking shelter from the
rain too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's like a squall ringing from the south.
As though
a thunder spirit is unleashing
its wrath upon the
earth. Listen, here it
comes again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boom! Boom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, for there is no storm without
sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look to yonder sky, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: H-huh? It's already cleared up...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The thunderclouds are soaked in
vermillion, for
they cannot shroud the
sky forever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And before long, we shall witness...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The stars—too many to grasp, much less
count by
hand—blanketing the sky.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, as one player leaves the stage,
another
steps forward to play the lead.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um... one, two, three, four, five, six,
seven, eight,
nine, ten...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've won more times than I can
count by
hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To think there would ever be an
Umamusume to
win eleven G1 dirt
races... it's the stuff legends
are made of.
choice_data_list: ああ、GⅠ勝利数、10を越えたな
うん、GⅠ勝利数、10を越えたね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that's over 10 G1 victories now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eleven... Oh. That reminds me of a feng
shui
reading I did to see my long-term
future.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I saw eleven stars. It must have been a
portent...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, I never imagined it would come
true this
fast! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her momentum was like a shooting star
blazing
through the sky. And on the day
of the awards
ceremony...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Big Thanks! I really
appreciate
your warm welcome today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I was able to win so
many G1
races is thanks to everyone's
support, all my
friends, and, of course,
my trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you guys don't mind, I'd like you to
give
another round of applause with
equal enthusiasm
to my friends and
trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Rickey looks so thrilled. And she's even
thinking
of us...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Having everyone's eyes on me like
this... I
think I'm more nervous than her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She never, ever forgets to consider the
people
around her, and it is exactly that
attitude that led
her to such a grand
achievement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her victory isn't just a coincidence—it
comes from
the careful arrangement of
her environment built
on a rock-solid
foundation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's one more person I have
to show
my appreciation for.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Will you come with me? I wouldn't be
able to go
if I hadn't gotten this
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the place Copano Rickey heads
toward
is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, he's here! See, Kita? ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey there! It's been a while!

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the park that Copano Rickey and
Kitasan
Black used to play in together as
children.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Here, the person who allowed them to
run around
freely stands there with a
kind expression on his
face.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Because of all that you did
for me...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was able to win so many races! Kita has
also
been running really well herself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could give you a piece of the
trophy. ♪
No matter how much I thank
you, it'll never be
enough! ☆

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course. I always watch you two
on TV!

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
I don't need you to share that trophy
though. I've
already gotten so much from
you two.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you two dash energetically
around the
track like you used to, and
coming back safe and
sound—that's
more than enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
I want you to keep running with smiles
on your
faces. That is my only wish.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: We will! Thank you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you must be Rickey's trainer, if I'm
not
mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Please take care of little Rickey for me!
She's
always been like a daughter to me.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Again, you say?
choice_data_list: はい、また連れてきます
ええ、また連れてきます
choice_data_list_en: Yes, I'll bring her along again.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: An old home... You don't say.
choice_data_list: この公園は2人の故郷みたいなものですから
choice_data_list_en: After all, this park is like a home to the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! This is where I first
learned to
run. For me, it's an incredibly
important place. ☆
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We'll be back! When I get the chance,
I'll visit
again with Kita! ♪

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Sure, drop by whenever you like. We'll
all be
waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, someday in the distant future,
Copano
Rickey will spend time at this
park, watching the
days go by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that is still a long way off. For
now,
she'll focus on racking up more and
more victories
before she returns.
